scope: Public Saskatchewan child care centre funding applications. Research inventory only; not a complete ministry form library or an approved digital replacement.

forms.title: Child Care Centre Space Development Capital Grant Application
forms.stage: opening or expansion, after space approval
forms.purpose: Funding approval, separate from licence approval.
forms.verification: Form named in official information sheet, page 2; actual application not retrieved.
attachments: Mailing address and postal code confirmation
conditions: Submit after ministry approval of spaces; capital funding requires its own approval.
Use funds for eligible physical-space development; return ineligible or unused funds and retain expenditure records.
forms.implementation: Do not invent an official field-level form. A proposed application can reuse organization, project, budget and banking data, but label its unverified sections.

forms.title: Enhanced Accessibility Request
forms.purpose: Additional staffing support for inclusion; not a licence prerequisite.
forms.verification: Current publication download retrieved; both pages extracted, 101 AcroForm fields enumerated. No printed date visible.
applicantFields: Monthly hours, wage before enhancement, mandatory employer costs
Educator employment, shared support, name and certification
attachments: Personal Program Plan accompanies the application or follows within four weeks, per separate guidelines
conditions: Additional educator is outside regular staff-child ratios.
Notify consultant immediately of relevant enrolment or parent employment/training changes; report shared support arrangements.
forms.implementation: Keep office-use calculations separate from applicant inputs. Link this request to the broader inclusion application and consent, not only a financial total.

forms.title: Child Care Application for Tuition Reimbursement
forms.verification: Current official download retrieved; both pages extracted, first-page image inspected and all AcroForm fields enumerated.
applicantFields: Names, prior names, gender and birth date
Certification/date, position, wage including top-up, employment dates/type
Facility entity number and facility/site name
Up to five courses: name/number, institution, completion date, tuition and book costs
attachments: Official or unofficial transcripts showing completion
conditions: Submit within one year after successful completion.
Exclude costs paid fully by other funding; unreimbursed portions may qualify up to $1,500/course.
International students are excluded by this template.
Employee declaration prevents duplicate claims.
forms.currentPolicyCaveat: Current EY02/2026 download resolves the stale $500 search-index copy: this template states $1,500/course. Regulatory maximum and individual approval remain distinct.
forms.implementation: Reuse entity and staff information with restricted access. Preserve separate employer and employee declarations; expenses and completion evidence remain course-specific.
forms.submission: Email completed form and required evidence to childcare@gov.sk.ca.

forms.title: Application for Reimbursement of Professional Development Expenses 2026-27
forms.stage: optional operating, after an eligible event
forms.verification: Current official download retrieved; both pages extracted, claim table visually inspected, AcroForm fields enumerated. Supersedes stale indexed 2024–25 copy.
applicantFields: Facility name, entity ID and community
Each attendee, eligible event and completion date
Registration, travel, meals and eligible staffing stipend
attachments: Required expense receipts; form explicitly requires accommodation receipts
conditions: Submit within two months of event.
Use funding to reimburse whoever incurred expenses.
Stipend must match the current eligible-opportunities list; do not claim it during facility PD closures.
forms.currentPolicyCaveat: Application is 2026–27, but the currently downloadable general information sheet (product74952/format83851) still covers 2025–26. Use the applicable-year eligible-opportunities list and obtain matching guidance; do not carry over its expired deadline or travel rates.
forms.implementation: Repeating event/attendee claims with automatic arithmetic, distinct retained attendance evidence and applicant declaration. Ministry determines eligibility.
recordsRetained: Attendance certificate, or Professional Development Reflection Form when no certificate is issued, retained for consultant review

forms.title: Training Support Grant Application
forms.stage: optional operating, staff release for formal studies
forms.verification: Official PDF text inspected, including Parts I–III. Published template age is explicit; current acceptance not independently confirmed.
applicantFields: Centre operating name, postal address, email and phone
Staff member, training option, institution and course
Monthly release blocks, half-days and full-days
attachments: Proof of staff coverage when requested
conditions: Use funding for substitute/alternate coverage while educators pursue eligible studies.
Update staff/course information when needed.
Form caps support at $500 per course monthly and $1,500 per educator monthly; these maxima agree with regulation 92.2.
forms.implementation: Use repeating educator/course/month records, not one total text box. Keep release-time arithmetic distinct from approval.

forms.title: Inclusion Program Grant Application
forms.verification: Official completion guidelines inspected; actual application PDF not retrieved. Sections below are guideline descriptions, not complete field inventory.
applicantFields: Facility support and ongoing communication plans
reviewerFields: Consultant makes final funding-level decision after team discussion
attachments: Enhanced Accessibility Personal Program Plan: with application or within four weeks
conditions: Application is collaborative among family, facility, supporting professional and consultant.
Parent consent is required; reapplication precedes expiry.
forms.implementation: Separate parent, provider, professional and ministry contributions. Individual Inclusion, equipment and training/resource supports require linked decisions; do not infer a single provider-only checklist.

forms.implementation: Track as an optional later operating service. Do not fabricate a form from programme descriptions.

sources.title: Grants for Child Care Centres
sources.notes: Service page links only three application types; publication catalogues reveal additional current forms. Some page rates lag current downloads. Use the current form version, not search-index copy, for field mapping.

sources.title: Apply to Start a Regulated Child Care Centre
sources.notes: Funding eligibility is distinct from licensing: co-operatives, nonprofit corporations and municipalities may qualify for funding; adult individuals and for-profit corporations may pursue licensing without government funding. Initial proposals include a Community Needs Assessment and development/operating budgets. These opening forms are inventoried separately by the centre-form researcher.

sources.notes: After ministry notification: licence application, direct-deposit/banking documents, signed capital agreement and applicable grant applications. It does not enumerate every grant application or provide a single combined approval.

limitations: Web search indexed superseded filenames even when current download URLs served newer forms. Final records prioritize directly downloaded current catalogue files. Earlier partial/index-only findings are retained as source-history notes, not current requirements.

Exact current capital, standard inclusion, Skills Enhancement and ECE staff-information applications were not retrieved. Startup and other operating grant intake specifications also remain incomplete. Missing fields must not be fabricated.
Current PD application is2026–27 while linked general information download is2025–26. Obtain corresponding-year eligibility guidance and deadline before production.
Play and Exploration application and information sheet differ on submission versus retention of workshop certificates. Confirm timing, keeping document ownership and evidence obligations visible.
Budget Rev.08/03 is still publicly downloadable but is not proof of current reporting frequency or grant calculations. New development budget workbook is inventoried separately.
Home-only nutrition, equipment and startup forms are outside this centre inventory and must not be applied to centres.
Monthly enrolment and Parent Fee Reduction reporting are operating workflows distinct from opening. Internal portal fields were not inspected here.
Referenced-only records have empty field arrays because no fields were verified; this does not establish absence of reviewer fields.
All source documents were blank public forms. No applications were submitted and no dashboard or model code was changed.
